title: How a Godly Man Builds Friendships That Actually Call Him Out
caption:
How a godly man builds friendships that actually call him out.

Not the group chat. The two guys who'd notice if he went quiet for a week.

Twelve guys who like his posts can't do what two guys who have his number can. Trade the size of the group for the depth of it, then tell them what he's actually carrying.

A friendship that's watched the same struggle for two years is worth more than ten that only ever saw the highlight reel.
